name: fidy-ai-mutation-tools
description: Isolated classic-TypeScript install for StrykerJS. Stryker rewrites tsconfig.json on its way into the sandbox through the classic `typescript` compiler API; the root package pins the Effect tsgo `typescript` build, which does not expose `parseConfigFileTextToJson`, so a root-resolved Stryker crashes before planting its first mutant. Keeping Stryker and a classic typescript here fixes the resolution without disturbing the root toolchain — and the local `vitest` pin gives the runner the same patched version as the root workspace. The pin tracks the classic 6.x line and stops there on purpose: typescript@7 ships no compiler API at all — its main entry resolves to a version stub — so there is nothing for the tsconfig rewrite to call. Revisit when TypeScript ships the replacement API and Stryker adopts it.
